samples.summary: Cell rewrite in `unsetRangeStyleValues` still routes through `compactCell`, silently dropping spill metadata the calculator depends on
samples.evidence: The delta moved the cell-level removal out of `removeCellStyleKeysInRange` into `unsetRangeStyleValues` but kept the same rewrite: `packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4374` does `compactCell(cell, nextStyle)` and `store.set(anchor, nextCell)`. `compactCell` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/style-mutation.ts:57-69) copies only `v`, `f` and `s`, so `spillRows`, `spillCols`, `spillAnchor` and `spillBlocked` (packages/sheets/src/model/core/types.ts:213-216) are erased. A dynamic-array anchor cell written by the calculator carries `s` *and* `spillRows`/`spillCols` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:136), and the calculator's ghost-cleanup path keys off exactly those fields (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:73-80). A Decrease-decimals click whose unset reaches such an anchor therefore orphans its spilled ghost cells — and because the delta runs this scan for column/row/all selections too, one sheet-wide click can reach every anchor at once. The fix belongs on the new code at sheet.ts:4373-4379 (preserve non-style cell fields instead of `compactCell`).

verdict.reason: Every claimed element verified. sheet.ts:4373-4379 rewrites matched cells with `compactCell(cell, nextStyle)` then `store.set(anchor, nextCell)`. `compactCell` (style-mutation.ts:57-69) constructs a fresh object copying only `v`, `f`, and `s`, so the spill bookkeeping fields declared at core/types.ts:213-216 are lost. The stores replace wholesale rather than merge: memory.ts:97-100 does `grid.set(sref, value)`, and yorkie-store.ts:213-254 re-copies spill fields only from the passed cell (lines 228-239) before writing, so a cell written without them ends up without them. Other modules depend on those fields: calculator.ts:74-84 gates ghost cleanup on `cell.spillRows && cell.spillCols && !cell.spillBlocked`, and calculator.ts:136 writes anchors as `{v, f, s: style, spillRows, spillCols}` where `style` derives from `cell.s`/applyInferredFormat (input.ts:312-340) and can legitimately contain `dp`/`nf`; sheet.ts:1007-1023 and 1086-1098 gate identically. Reachability is not guarded: the pre-scan at sheet.ts:4302-4315 filters only on `existing?.s` and value agreement, and omitStyleKeys (range-styles.ts:64-76) yields a rewrite whenever the cell's own style carries one of the requested keys — there is no `spillAnchor`/spill-anchor/formula exclusion here, unlike the spill-aware paths at sheet.ts:1001 and sheet.ts:3909. changeDecimals (sheet.ts:4205-4213) reaches it, and targets/ownsCols/ownsRows/ownsSheet (sheet.ts:4247-4253) let a column/row/whole-sheet selection scan every anchor at once, orphaning their ghost cells. Invariant other modules assume is broken by a rewrite outside their view — in the blast-radius lane, major.

finding.summary: New cell-level unset path rebuilds cells with `compactCell`, which silently drops spill metadata (`spillRows`/`spillCols`/`spillAnchor`/`spillBlocked`) that the calculator/renderer depend on
finding.evidence: `removeCellStyleKeysInRange` writes `await this.store.set(anchor, compactCell(existing, next))` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4366). `compactCell` only copies `v`, `f`, `s` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/style-mutation.ts:57-69), while `Cell` also carries `spillRows`, `spillCols`, `spillAnchor`, `spillBlocked` (packages/sheets/src/model/core/types.ts:209-217), which the array-formula code writes and reads: `sheet.setCell(ref, { v: anchorValue, f: cell.f, s: style, spillRows: rows, spillCols: cols })` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:136) and `if (cell.spillRows && cell.spillCols && !cell.spillBlocked)` in the paint/expansion loops (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:74, packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1086). So decreasing decimals back to the inherited precision over a styled spill anchor erases its spill region metadata until the next recalculation. (Note: `setStyle` at sheet.ts:3682 already has this shape, so the invariant may already be violated elsewhere; the fix belongs in the new code — preserve the non-style fields, e.g. `{ ...existing, s: next }`-style compaction.)

verdict.reason: Verified in the repo. `compactCell` builds a fresh Cell copying only v/f/s (style-mutation.ts:57-69), dropping spillRows/spillCols/spillAnchor/spillBlocked which are real Cell fields (core/types.ts:213-216). The unset path rebuilds and writes cells wholesale via `compactCell(cell, nextStyle)` + `store.set` (sheet.ts:4374-4378) inside `unsetRangeStyleValues` (sheet.ts:4238), reachable from the decrease-decimals path at sheet.ts:4210. The cell scan (sheet.ts:4294-4315) has no skip for formula cells or spill anchors/ghosts, unlike the explicit `if (cell?.f || cell?.spillAnchor) continue;` guard that exists on a different path (sheet.ts:3909) — so no guard makes this unreachable. Store `set` replaces rather than merges (memory.ts:97-100; yorkie-store.ts:259-290 normalizes only fields present, normalizeCell at 213-254), so the fields are truly lost. Anchors can hold cell-level style, since the calculator writes `{v, f, s: style, spillRows, spillCols}` (calculator.ts:136). Consumers outside the diff depend on the metadata for ghost cleanup/paint: calculator.ts:74 and sheet.ts:1007-1023, 1086-1098. That is a violated invariant other modules assume — in-lane for blast radius and blocking at major. The only inaccuracies in the finding are cosmetic: the helper is now inlined into `unsetRangeStyleValues` rather than named `removeCellStyleKeysInRange`, and the write is at 4374/4378 rather than 4366. The reviewer's note that setStyle (sheet.ts:3682) shares the shape does not refute it, and per instructions I do not judge whether the change introduced the code.
